command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY_EOF'
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import secrets

source = "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt"
destination = "/etc/web-boundary/auth.json"
with open(source, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    text = handle.read()
user_match = re.search(r"^Demonstration account:\s*(\S+)\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
pass_match = re.search(r"^Demonstration password:[REDACTED], text, re.MULTILINE)
if not user_match or not pass_match:
    raise SystemExit("credential fields not found")
salt = secrets.token_bytes(32)
iterations = 310000
digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
    "sha256", pass_match.group(1).encode("utf-8"), salt, iterations
)
payload = {
    "username": user_match.group(1),
    "iterations": iterations,
    "salt": base64.b64encode(salt).decode("ascii"),
    "digest": base64.b64encode(digest).decode("ascii"),
}
temporary = destination + ".new"
with open(temporary, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(payload, handle)
    handle.write("\n")
os.replace(temporary, destination)
PY_EOF
chown webboundary:webboundary /etc/web-boundary/auth.json
chmod 0600 /etc/web-boundary/auth.json
printf 'runtime verifier created from access.txt without emitting secrets\n'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/web-boundary/auth.json /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt

command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/systemd/system/web-boundary.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Public and staff authentication-boundary web service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=webboundary
Group=webboundary
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/web-boundary-server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6
ReadOnlyPaths=/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public
ReadOnlyPaths=/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff
InaccessiblePaths=/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now web-boundary.service
systemctl is-enabled web-boundary.service
systemctl is-active web-boundary.service

set -eu
check_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/restart-recovery.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$check_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled web-boundary.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active web-boundary.service
ss -ltn '( sport = :8080 )'
base="http://$NODE_IP:8080"
public_code=$(curl -sS -o "$check_dir/public" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/public/")
staff_denied=$(curl -sS -o "$check_dir/denied" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/staff/")
staff_wrong=$(curl -sS -u "reader:${DEMO_PASSWORD}x" -o "$check_dir/wrong" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/staff/")

access_code=$(curl -sS --path-as-is -o "$check_dir/access" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/access.txt")
traversal_code=$(curl -sS --path-as-is -o "$check_dir/traversal" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/public/%2e%2e/access.txt")
listing_code=$(curl -sS -o "$check_dir/listing" -w '%{http_code}' "$base/public/not-a-directory/")
printf 'public=%s/%s staff_denied=%s staff_wrong=%s staff_allowed=%s/%s roster=%s/%s access=%s traversal=%s missing_directory=%s\n' "$public_code" "$(cmp -s "$check_dir/public" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/index.html && printf exact || printf mismatch)" "$staff_denied" "$staff_wrong" "$staff_allowed" "$(cmp -s "$check_dir/staff" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html && printf exact || printf mismatch)" "$roster_allowed" "$(cmp -s "$check_dir/roster" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/roster.csv && printf exact || printf mismatch)" "$access_code" "$traversal_code" "$listing_code"
printf 'staged_data_sha256\n'; sha256sum /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/index.html /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/roster.csv /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt
printf 'access_permissions='; stat -c '%A %U:%G' /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/access.txt
[ "$public_code" = 200 ] && [ "$staff_denied" = 401 ] && [ "$staff_wrong" = 401 ] && [ "$staff_allowed" = 200 ] && [ "$roster_allowed" = 200 ] && [ "$access_code" = 404 ] && [ "$traversal_code" = 404 ] && [ "$listing_code" = 404 ]
cmp -s "$check_dir/public" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/index.html
cmp -s "$check_dir/staff" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/index.html
cmp -s "$check_dir/roster" /srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/roster.csv
